=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text msg "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs! Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow."
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitc writes one byte
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
note counts the letters a..z, upper and lower case together, and prints every letter with its count
fn main to int
f = new ulong 26 0
for i ulong len msg
c = get msg i
if and ge c 65 le c 90
c = add c 32
end
if and ge c 97 le c 122
put f sub c 97 add get f sub c 97 1
end
end
for j ulong 26
emitc add uchar j 97
emit sp
emitu get f j
emit nl
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
a 4
b 3
c 3
d 3
e 6
f 3
g 3
h 4
i 5
j 3
k 3
l 3
m 3
n 3
o 9
...
s 3
t 4
u 6
v 3
w 3
x 3
y 3
z 3
</pre>
